Walk-In-Interview for the appointment of Guest Faculty
Walk-In-Interview for the post of Assistant Professor as Guest Faculty for
following subjects will be conducted on 17.01.2023 (Tuesday) at 12.30 PM
at Rajiv Gandhi College Bhawan, Panjab University, Chandigarh
Subject Name Nos of Vacancy Date of
Interview
Time of
Interview
Physical Education 1 17.1.2023 12.30 PM
Political Science 1 17.1.2023 12.30 PM
Salary: As per UGC/Panjab University Regulation
Venue: Rajiv Gandhi College Bhawan, Panjab University Chandigarh
Important instructions:
1. Qualifications will as per Panjab University/UGC norms.
2. Interested candidates are advised to download application proforma
from P.U. website, affix latest passport size colour photograph,
attached one set of photocopy of all documents (self attested) and
bring on the interview venue.
3. Application proforma for Direct recruitment of Assistant Professor
(As per UGC Regulation 2018) can be downloaded from Panjab
University Jobs site:https://jobs.puchd.ac.in/show-forms.php.
4. On the interview date candidates are advised to carry all original
documents for verification without which No interview will be
conducted.
5. No TA/DA will be paid to the candidates for appearing interview.
Sd/-
Principal
